symptom: Applying several themes as a set is never idempotent — `mxcli-fonts/OFL.txt` reports `updated` on every run, forever — and the installed licence covers the wrong fonts
cause: Every theme vendored a different font family and wrote its SIL OFL text to the *same* path. With one theme installed the last apply won and it settled; with a set, each theme overwrote the previous one on every pass
insight: **Two themes writing different content to one verbatim path is a licensing bug before it is a churn bug** — the churn is just the symptom that made it visible. `TestThemesDoNotClaimTheSameVerbatimPathWithDifferentContent` hashes every non-fenced file across every theme and fails on a collision; controlled by renaming them back, which reproduces the original failure
